texte.Demande enregistrée. CONSEILPREV vous re: Request recorded. CONSEILPREV will get back to you.
texte.Demander une dérogation si le modèle ne: Request a derogation if the model does not present a systemic risk despite the threshold
texte.Demandez à votre directeur de programme: Ask your programme director to update it before each executive committee.
texte.Deployeur GPAI tiers - verifiez les poli: Third-party GPAI deployer - check the provider policies and Art. # obligations.
texte.Depuis la vue pays ou la carte, cliquez: From the country view or the map, click a centre: its record physically separates what the operator HAS MADE PUBLIC — with source, source type and confidence level — from what WE CALCULATE, with ranges and formulas displayed. The assumptions (PUE, WUE, load factor, template) are given figure by figure so that your analyst can redo the calculation with their own values — and challenge us with the result.
texte.Dernière revue de conformité privacy il: Time since last privacy compliance review:
texte.Dernière étape avant production : valide: Last step before production: validate full privacy compliance
texte.Des actions ordonnées par ce qu’elles ra: Actions ordered by what they actually earn, including those that serve several standards at once.
texte.Des cas d’usage sont retenus dans la car: Use cases are included in the mapping.
texte.Des chiffres dont la couverture est écri: Figures with their coverage written alongside: it is the first thing an auditor will ask for, before the value itself.
texte.Des chiffres dont vous répondez, avec le: Figures you answer for, with their assumptions written down — the only ones admissible in a non-financial report.
texte.Des moyens financiers, humains ou techni: Financial, human or technical resources are allocated (#)
texte.Des ordres de grandeur défendables, et l: Defensible orders of magnitude, and the manufacturing share — the majority as soon as the grid is decarbonised, invisible on a map that only showed use.
texte.Des points de comparaison réels pour sit: Real points of comparison to situate your own uses, and the vulnerabilities already observed by type of system.
texte.Des valeurs dont chacune porte sa source: Values that each carry their source and their nature — regulatory text, reading, or the firm’s assumption.
texte.Descendez les chapitres dans l’ordre : c: Work down the chapters in order: each carries what brings it down in an audit, and each question carries its paragraph number and its title. The batch button answers for a whole chapter when the answer is the same throughout — to be re-read afterwards question by question, because that is where the gaps are. Four answers: met, partly met, absent, not applicable.
texte.Descendez les exigences de votre rôle, p: Work down the requirements for your role, paragraph by paragraph.
texte.Descendez les soixante-cinq paragraphes,: Work down the sixty-five paragraphs, chapter by chapter. The batch button answers for a whole chapter when the answer is the same throughout.
texte.Description des processus concernés, pér: Description of the processes concerned, period and frequency of use, categories of persons affected, identified risks of harm, human oversight and redress measures. To be notified to the supervisory authority. What is already covered by the GDPR impact assessment can be taken over by cross-reference (Art. #(#)).
texte.Detection assistee d anomalies sur image: Assisted anomaly detection in medical imaging (X-ray, MRI).
texte.Detection automatique des risques et inc: Automatic detection of risks and incidents (Art. #(#)(c))
texte.Detection automatisee de defauts sur lig: Automated defect detection on a production line.
texte.Detection automatisee de depassements de: Automated detection of pollution threshold exceedances.
texte.Detection automatisee de derive de perfo: Automated detection of performance drift in deployed AI models.
texte.Detection d objets ou comportements susp: Detection of suspicious objects or behaviour
texte.Detection de clauses abusives ou a risqu: Detection of unfair or risky clauses
texte.Detection de comportements d acces anorm: Detection of abnormal access behaviour and adjustment of rights.
texte.Detection de discrimination dans l attri: Detection of discrimination in the allocation of services
texte.Detection de fuites ou de risques d expl: Detection of leaks or explosion risks
texte.Detection de schemas de transactions sus: Detection of suspicious money-laundering transaction patterns.
texte.Detection de signaux faibles de risque r: Detection of weak signals of reputational risk
texte.Detection et correction des biais identi: Detection and correction of biases identified in the data (Art. #(#))
texte.Deux approbateurs sur un même processus,: Two approvers on the same process means none: the decision gets passed back and forth. It is the most frequent defect, and the costliest on the day of an incident.
texte.Deux chapitres n’ont d’équivalent dans a: Two chapters have no counterpart in either ISO standard: the regulatory compliance strategy of §#, and operation and control. That is exactly what the Regulation adds to an ordinary QMS.
texte.Deux chapitres n’ont d’équivalent nulle: Two chapters have no counterpart anywhere
texte.Deux extractions des mêmes journaux, à t: Two extractions of the same logs, at thirty and at ninety days, on the same named cohort. Without the start date written somewhere, the figure means nothing.
texte.Deux obligations qui se traitent avant l: Two obligations that are dealt with before deployment and become impossible to catch up afterwards.
texte.Deux référentiels, et le second n'est pa: Two frameworks, and the second is not one more standard: SP #-# OVERLAYS SP #-# for industry. Its Appendix G says so in so many words. This path takes them in the order in which they are built — the catalogue, then what the process adds to it — because the reverse has you reading a tailoring without knowing of what.
texte.Deux régimes peuvent obtenir un score vo: Two regimes can obtain a similar score by opposite routes — one demanding on data, the other on transparency. Read the dimensions, not only the total.
texte.Deux sorties possibles y sont vérifiées: Two possible exits are checked there before anything else: it may not be an AI system, and it may not be up to you to carry the regime.
texte.Deux taux : le global, et celui des neuf: Two rates: the global one, and the one for the nine clauses that # really adds. It is the second that says where the budget goes.
texte.Diagnostic de cadrage — à valider avec l: Scoping diagnostic — to be validated with the IT department and the business lines. Scale: # absent, # under construction, # mastered. Generated by Sentinel AI.
texte.Diagnostic de maturité data et compétenc: Data maturity and technical skills diagnostic
texte.Diagnostic vocal automatise des pannes b: Automated voice diagnosis of box/mobile faults before transfer to an agent.
texte.Difference AI Act et NIS# ?: Difference between the AI Act and NIS #?
texte.Diffusez ce réflexe aux chefs de projet: Spread this reflex among AI project managers: qualify before coding, not after.
texte.Direction commerciale & développement —: Sales & business development department — where the market is, and what it costs
texte.Direction de l’exploitation — arbitrer s: Operations department — deciding on an estate, not on a site
texte.Direction générale, CAIO, conformité, DP: Executive management, CAIO, compliance, DPO, CISO, AI programme managers
texte.Direction générale, conformité, DSI, DPO: Executive management, compliance, IT department, DPO
texte.Direction — dois-je faire certifier mon: Senior management — should I have my AI management system certified?
texte.Direction, RH, responsables de la transf: Senior management, HR, transformation leads, future ambassadors
texte.Dirigeant — c’est moi que l’article # no: Manager — I am the one Article # names
texte.Dirigeants, chefs de projet, juristes, D: Managers, project managers, lawyers, IT department
texte.Distingue une architecture éprouvée d’un: Distinguishes a proven architecture from a fashionable one — the latter is paid for at the handover.
texte.Distinguer la personnalisation légitime: Distinguish legitimate personalisation (Art. # → transparency) from manipulative practices (Art. # → prohibition). The line can be thin depending on the techniques used.
texte.Distinguer les usages internes des conte: Distinguish internal uses from published content — only the latter triggers the labelling obligation.
texte.Distinguer votre empreinte de celle de v: Distinguishing your footprint from that of your tools
texte.Distinguez les publics : tout le monde n: Distinguish between audiences: not everyone has the same obligations. The teams that handle sensitive data and those that design processing activities call for separate sessions. Export the plan to have it validated.
texte.Distributeur (met à disposition sur le m: Distributor (makes available on the EU market)
texte.Distributeur — je mets à disposition san: Distributor — I make available without designing or importing
texte.Distribution, négoce, commerce de détail: Distribution, trading, physical and online retail, marketplaces.
texte.Dix défaillances qui reviennent, classée: Ten recurring failure modes, ranked by observed frequency. It is neither a standard nor a certifiable framework: you do not comply with it, you use it as a checklist. The path ends on the awkward question: what your ISO/IEC # certification does not give you.
texte.Document contractuel généré par Sentinel: Contractual document generated by Sentinel AI. The thresholds and amounts are those of the payment schedule in force on the date of issue. CONSEILPREV — Christophe CERF — christophe.cerf@outlook.com
texte.Document de cadrage — cas d’usage qualif: Scoping document — qualified use cases (weighted scoring: impact # %, feasibility # %, data # %, risk under control # %) and prioritised (P# ≥ #; P# ≥ #). Estimates to be validated with the business lines and the IT department. Generated by Sentinel AI.
texte.Document de conformité RGPD (art. #). À: GDPR compliance document (art. #). To be kept up to date and validated with the data protection officer. Generated by Sentinel.
texte.Document généré automatiquement par Sent: Document generated automatically by Sentinel AI from the actual data in your AI register. Print (Ctrl+P) or save as PDF.
texte.Document généré depuis Sentinel. Les ind: Document generated from Sentinel. The indices reflect the state of your assessments on the date of issue.
texte.Document généré par IA à partir des résu: Document generated by AI from the results of the maturity audit. To be validated by an expert. CONSEILPREV — Christophe CERF — +# # # # # # — christophe.cerf@outlook.com
texte.Document généré par un système d’intelli: Document generated by an artificial intelligence system (AI Act, art. #).
texte.Document interne CONSEILPREV — données d: CONSEILPREV internal document — client follow-up data strictly for internal use. Generated by Sentinel AI.
texte.Document méthodologique généré par IA à: Methodology document generated by AI from the results of the maturity audit. To be validated by an expert. CONSEILPREV — Christophe CERF — +# # # # # # — christophe.cerf@outlook.com
texte.Document produit par la plateforme Senti: Document produced by the Sentinel platform; some sections may be generated by AI (AI Act, art. #).
texte.Document technique. Ne constitue ni une: Technical document. It constitutes neither a regulatory declaration under Article L. #-# of the Code de l’environnement [Environmental Code] nor a legal opinion. The factors and parameters must be reviewed at least annually.
texte.Documentation claire sur les capacités,: Clear documentation of capabilities, limitations, performance, conditions of intended use and restrictions.
texte.Documentation des mesures d’attenuation: Documentation of mitigation measures and their effectiveness
texte.Documentation des sources, methodes de c: Documentation of sources, collection methods and processing applied
texte.Documentation technique des modeles GPAI: Technical documentation of GPAI models drawn up (Art. #(#)(a))
texte.Documentation technique et resume d entr: Technical documentation and training summary of GPAI models
texte.Documentation technique, contrat fournis: Technical documentation, supplier contract, marking policy, screenshots…
texte.Documentation technique, politique de dr: Technical documentation, a copyright policy respecting rights holders’ reservations, a publicly available summary of the training content, cooperation with the AI Office.
texte.Documente formellement un risque souvent: Formally documents a risk that is often underestimated: the human impact, not only the technical one.
texte.Documente l’impact humain, que les indic: Documents the human impact, which a model’s performance indicators never measure.
texte.Documenter et justifier toute décision d: Document and justify every moderation decision
texte.Documenter et traiter toute non-conformi: Document and address any non-compliance identified
texte.Documenter l'analyse via l'outil dédié (: Document the analysis using the dedicated tool (Sentinel’s FRIA module)
texte.Documenter l'investigation et les action: Document the investigation and the corrective actions taken after reporting
texte.Documenter l'origine et les caractéristi: Document the origin and characteristics of the training data
texte.Documenter la décision de classification: Document the classification decision before placing on the market — including where the exception of Art. #(#) is invoked (Art. #(#)) — and register the system (Art. #(#))
texte.Documenter la finalité précise de chaque: Document the precise purpose of each AI processing activity from the design stage
texte.Documenter le contexte interne et extern: Document the internal and external context relevant to your AI systems
texte.Documenter les actions menées — sans pré: Document the actions carried out — without claiming to guarantee a given level for each person
texte.Documenter les biais identifiés et leur: Document the biases identified and how they are addressed (Art. #)
texte.Documenter les contrôles retenus et leur: Document the controls included and their justification (Statement of Applicability)
texte.Documenter les garanties mises en place: Document the safeguards in place (re-examination, explanation, challenge)
texte.Documenter les métriques de performance: Document the performance metrics in the technical file
texte.Documenter les procédures de contrôle et: Document the oversight and intervention procedures
texte.Documenter quelles données sont accessib: Document which data is accessible — a poorly partitioned RAG agent can expose sensitive data.
texte.Documenter techniquement le fonctionneme: Technically document how the model works so that you can respond
texte.Documenter une AIIA pour les systèmes à: Document an AIIA for systems with a potentially high impact on individuals or society
texte.Documentez précisément les jeux de donné: Document precisely the datasets used by each AI system.
texte.Documentez systématiquement la base léga: Always document the legal basis of the processing for each system, from the moment it is recorded.
texte.Donne une trajectoire claire vers l’éché: Gives a clear trajectory towards the # December # deadline (high-risk obligations, Annex III).
texte.Données : disponibilité, qualité et acce: Data: availability, quality and accessibility of the data needed. # = insufficient, # = ready.
texte.Données financières, ESG, incidents, dép: Financial and ESG data, incidents, dependency.
texte.Données sensibles (Art. # RGPD) et systè: Sensitive data (Art. # GDPR) and AI systems
texte.Données sensibles RGPD Art. #. Hébergeme: Sensitive data, GDPR Art. #. Certified HDS (Health Data Host) hosting mandatory in France.
texte.Dossier de preuve exportable en DOCX et: Evidence file exportable as DOCX and PDF, with AI marking carried in the file metadata (Art. # of Regulation (EU) #/#), including the exact name of the model used.
texte.Dossier de valeur — estimations de cadra: Business case — scoping estimates to be validated with the business lines and the finance department. Net return, year # = annual gain − project cost − recurring cost. Generated by Sentinel AI.
texte.Dossier documentaire — sources, millésim: Documentation file — sources, editions, assumptions, formulas — exportable as DOCX and PDF, with AI marking carried in the file metadata (Art. # of Regulation (EU) #/#), including the exact name of the model used.
texte.Dossier technique complet avant mise sur: Complete technical file before placing on the market: architecture, data, performance, limitations, conformity assessment. SMEs, start-ups and small mid-cap enterprises: simplified form established by the Commission (Art. #(#)).
texte.Dossier technique complet établi avant m: Complete technical file drawn up before placing on the market, in accordance with Annex IV. It contains: general description, architecture, data used, conformity assessment, performance and limitations.
texte.Double evaluation de conformite (EU AI A: Dual conformity assessment (EU AI Act + MDR/IVDR)
texte.Double régime : EU AI Act + Règlement di: Dual regime: EU AI Act + Medical Devices Regulation (MDR/IVDR). Conformity assessment by a notified body mandatory.
texte.Droit d'exprimer son point de vue: Right to express one’s point of view
texte.Droit d'opposition aux décisions automat: Right to object to automated decisions
texte.Droit de contestation : par quel canal,: Right to challenge: through which channel, within what time limit?
texte.Droit de ne pas faire l'objet d'une déci: Right not to be subject to a decision based solely on automated processing (including profiling) which produces legal effects or similarly significantly affects the person. # strict exceptions: contractual necessity, legal authorisation, explicit consent.
texte.Droit à l explication et droit de recour: Right to explanation and right of redress
texte.Duplication manuelle des scores du table: Manual duplication of the scores from the JURS table on the Overview page. Risk of desynchronisation if the source scores are modified without being carried over here.
texte.Dès qu'ils attribuent des missions sur l: As soon as they assign jobs based on a worker’s behaviour or characteristics, or monitor their performance. A round optimised on travel time alone is not in scope; a round optimised on the worker’s rating is.
texte.Direction — je veux savoir où nous en so: Senior management — I want to know where we stand on the sixteen, and where to start
